nav.unlockStarMap1: Research Star Map Lv1 to unlock
nav.unlockStarMap2: Research Star Map Lv2 to unlock

empire.title: Empire
empire.raidHint: Last attack on this planet — jump to the defense tile
empire.rowEnergyDeficit: Not enough energy — {n} short, buildings offline

salvage.title: Salvage
salvage.intro: Cast the salvage beam into the debris field. When the echo jumps, lock on in time.
salvage.holdEmpty: Hold full — catches go back over the side
salvage.cabinetHint: Each one only once — artefacts are not charged to the hold. Tap a slot for details.

signal_buoy.name: Orphaned Signal Buoy
signal_buoy.lore: Still broadcasting the distress call of a convoy that stopped existing years ago.

trawl_coil.name: Trimmed Trawl Coil
trawl_coil.lore: Rewound by hand. Whoever did it understood salvage better than the shipyard did.

winch_drum.name: Salvaged Anchor Winch
winch_drum.lore: Hauling on a cable that has had nothing on the end of it for decades.

cargo_frame.name: Extended Cargo Frame
cargo_frame.lore: Cut out of a heavy hauler. It does not fit — it holds anyway.

scrap_cache.name: Forgotten Scrap Cache
scrap_cache.lore: Neatly sorted, neatly lashed down, never collected.

pay_chest.name: Pay Chest
pay_chest.lore: A whole shift's wages, sealed on payday. The shift never came back.

derelict.name: Gutted Derelict
derelict.lore: Two decks, no name, no bodies. Someone got here first — but not thoroughly.

sealed_drum.name: Sealed Cargo Drum
sealed_drum.lore: Seal intact, customs mark ground off. The contents do not ask for papers.

reactor_shard.name: Reactor Shard
reactor_shard.lore: Still warm. The engineers advise against looking at it for long.

medbay_locker.name: Medbay Locker
medbay_locker.lore: Four ampoules of vital gel and a note to a crew that no longer reads.

plating_bundle.name: Bundle of Hull Plating
plating_bundle.lore: Yard-fresh, never fitted. The freighter never made it to the yard.

foundry_haul.name: Foundry Haul
foundry_haul.lore: Half-set melt out of a burst furnace — finished in transit, which the yard never managed.

void_mask.name: Void Mask
void_mask.lore: Ritual mask of a sect that worshipped the vacuum. They wore it without a helmet — exactly once.

pilot_helmet.name: Star Pilot's Helmet
pilot_helmet.lore: Visor scoured blind by a decade of dust. The call sign underneath is still legible.

fleet_crown.name: Crown of the First Fleet
fleet_crown.lore: No title, no office — a medal a crew forged for itself once nobody else came.

deep_pilgrim.name: Deep Pilgrim
deep_pilgrim.lore: The helm of a species that held the debris field sacred. They came to pray, not to salvage.

tile.selectTile: Select an unlocked tile to manage buildings
tile.costOnce: One-off build cost, from this planet's stock
tile.costEnergy: Extra continuous draw over the current level — tied up, not paid
tile.costStaff: Extra workers over the current level — assigned for good
tile.homeOnlyHint: Only available on the home planet
tile.convCountHint: How many units this order makes — all delivered together at the end of the full run time
tile.convCountLocked: Order running — the facility is locked until it delivers
tile.convOrder: Order {n} units · all costs up front · delivered in {time}
tile.convBatchRunning: Order of {n} units running — delivered at the end, then orderable again
tile.convEmptyNoRefinery: Build the refinery to unlock conversions
tile.convEmptyNoFacility: Build a High-Tech facility to unlock conversions

onboarding.title: Welcome, Commander — your colony begins here
onboarding.step1: 🏛️ Build the Command Center — the heart of every colony
onboarding.step2: 👥 Recruit population on the base tile — you need workers for your buildings
onboarding.step3: 🔋 Build the Power Plant and charge its battery — without charge the colony has no power
onboarding.step4: ⛏️ Raise the Metal Mine and Crystal Drill to level 1 — your basic income
onboarding.step5: 📡 Research Star Map in the Comm Center to explore your solar system
onboarding.step6: 🛸 Discover a foreign planet with a recon drone
onboarding.step7: 🚀 Colonize a second planet and specialize each one
onboarding.step8: 📦 Send a cargo drone to another planet
onboarding.step9: 🔭 Scan a foreign star system on the galaxy map
onboarding.step10: 🕵️ Survey a foreign planet with a spy drone
onboarding.step11: 📡 Place a spy satellite in orbit of a surveyed planet

dock.reconDroneDesc: Scout planets in your home system
dock.cargoDroneDesc: Ships high-tech goods to any known planet
dock.crewHint: Crew: {crew} free workers board the ship
dock.noCrew: Not enough free workers for the crew
dock.launchFromSystemMap: Launch units from the System Map
dock.colonyCargoOnly: Drones and ships are built at the home planet only — a colony builds the cargo drone and nothing else.
dock.spyDroneDesc: Looks once at what kind of planet it is and who owns it, in a scanned foreign system
dock.spySatelliteDesc: Stays in orbit, keeps the finding current and measures the shield generator — until an orbital defense shoots it down
dock.launchFromGalaxyMap: Pick a target on the Galaxy Map
dock.corvetteDesc: Warship — 20 firepower against a foreign planet's shield and battery
dock.fleetAwayHint: Ships on a sortie keep their berth — they are coming back here
dock.fleetFull: Fleet limit reached — upgrade the weapons building
dock.needWeaponsHint: Warships need a weapons building — every level adds 4 berths
dock.batchHint: How many corvettes to order at once — one order, one build time, the squadron lands together

solar.pickTarget: Pick a target in the list
solar.settleHint: Planet colonized — start building your colony
solar.colonizeHint: Free planet — send a colony ship to claim it
solar.cargoSendHint: Loaded — now pick a known planet as the destination
solar.cargoOnePerPlanet: Only one cargo drone per planet
solar.colonizeNeedsShip: Free planet — build a colony ship at the dock first

galaxy.spyNoDrone: No spy drone in the dock
galaxy.spyHint: Only a spy drone reveals a planet's type and owner — and its report ages. A satellite keeps it current and also reports the shield — until the planet's orbital defense shoots it down.
galaxy.raidDisableDesc: Shield and battery to 0 — the planet stops producing
galaxy.raidPlunderDesc: Plus every refined good — the fleet loads in orbit and takes one more volley
galaxy.raidRecordHint: This commander has attacked you {n} times — won and repelled
galaxy.raidOutRecordHint: You have attacked this commander {n} times — won and repelled
galaxy.raidLogFleetHint: Corvettes launched — minus those shot down in orbit
galaxy.raidLogShieldHint: Shield charge before and after the battle
galaxy.raidLogBatteryHint: Reactor battery before and after the battle
galaxy.satelliteHint: Place a satellite in orbit — keeps the finding current and measures the shield until it is shot down (surveyed planets only)
galaxy.typeUnknown: Planet type unknown — a spy drone finds it out
galaxy.intelLiveSince: Satellite transmitting for {age} — current until it is shot down
galaxy.intelSnapshot: Snapshot from the last drone flight — may be out of date

comm.mutualScan: They've scanned your system — two-way contact possible

msg.territory: This region is under our protection.
msg.trade_interest: We are interested in future cooperation.

npc.npc_glad: We are glad to hear from you.
npc.npc_not_interested: We are not interested in contact.

battery.title: Reactor Battery
battery.hint: Drains over time. Empty = total power loss.
battery.swipe: Drag the contact left to right · +{n}%
battery.breakerHint: Pull the lever slowly to the right
battery.breakerFast: Too hasty — the breaker trips again

resourceBar.energyLowHint: Less than {n} energy to spare — the next building may not get powered
resourceBar.scrapHint: Salvage scrap — empire-wide, not per planet

shield.title: Shield strength
shield.hint: Fades over time. Recharging costs crystal.
shield.drag: Drag a crystal into the emitter · +{n}%
shield.carry: Carry it to the emitter — dropping it short costs nothing
shield.release: Let go — the emitter takes it
shield.noCrystal: Not enough crystal for a charge

orbitDefense.title: Orbital Defense
orbitDefense.clear: Orbit clear — no foreign satellites detected.
orbitDefense.fireHint: Destroy the satellite — its report freezes at the moment of the kill
orbitDefense.hint: Without this building foreign satellites stay invisible. A satellite transmits until it is shot down.

anomaly.idle: Quiet out there. The next event reaches the planet in a few hours.
anomaly.expiresHint: After that the event moves on
anomaly.prompt: Pick one of the two options — the other is lost

meteor.name: Meteor Shower
meteor.desc: A debris stream grazes the orbit. The salvage teams can only take one haul.

wreck.name: Derelict Freighter
wreck.desc: An abandoned freighter drifts in orbit. Salvage the hold or strip the hull?

solar_storm.name: Solar Storm
solar_storm.desc: The magnetosphere is glowing. The ion surge can be tapped once.

refugees.name: Refugee Convoy
refugees.desc: A convoy asks to dock. They can stay — or just refuel and move on.

comet.name: Comet Core
comet.desc: An ice core passes close by. Capturing it costs power cells.

drydock.name: Drifting Drydock
drydock.desc: A discarded orbital dock drifts past. Its hull presses still run — with enough metal you can cut armour plating.

reactor_core.name: Ejected Reactor Core
reactor_core.desc: A jettisoned reactor core is still glowing. Containing it costs crystal — or you let it burn out in a controlled vent.

dead_relay.name: Dead Relay
dead_relay.desc: A burnt-out relay station stopped answering. Its switching cores hold superconductor, its buffers hold old survey data.

bio_pod.name: Crashed Bio Pod
bio_pod.desc: A research pod with living cultures comes down. Growing them needs materials — or you just skim off the nutrient bath.

fuel_depot.name: Lost Fuel Depot
fuel_depot.desc: A forgotten tank depot drifts in orbit. Pumping it out costs lines and metal; scrapping it pays out at once.

trader.name: Wandering Trader
trader.desc: A freighter docks and opens its hold. He takes raw metal, nothing else.

ghost_ship.name: Ghost Ship
ghost_ship.desc: A crewless ship drifts past with its locks wide open. Boarding it costs a power cell.

stardust.name: Stardust Cloud
stardust.desc: The planet ploughs through a dense dust cloud. The filters catch whatever comes through.

recruit.title: Recruitment
recruit.full: Queue full — nobody else is coming
recruit.hint: Grows ~{rate}/day up to {max}. Click the person, not a button — missing costs nothing.

bubbles.b1: I choose to sleep in the engine room.
bubbles.b3: I've shot down a satellite before.
bubbles.b4: Radiation hasn't bothered me for ages.
bubbles.b7: I've still got all my fingers. Almost.
bubbles.b11: I dig deeper than the rest.
bubbles.b12: I can smell cryo through three metres of rock.
bubbles.b13: Last crew? Let's not talk about it.
bubbles.b14: I've been in a mine before. Twice.

comm_center.name: Comm Center
comm_center.desc: Global technologies — researched once, applied across all planets

spacebase.name: Space Base
spacebase.desc: Launch pad for drones and colony ships

anomaly.name: Anomaly
anomaly.desc: Passing events — each one a choice between two guaranteed outcomes

defense.name: Defense
defense.desc: Planetary shields, weapons platforms and early-warning systems

hightech.name: High-Tech
hightech.desc: Advanced material refinement and planet-exclusive processing

dock.name: Dock
dock.desc: Ship management, missions and fleet operations

salvage.name: Salvage
salvage.desc: Orbital debris field — cast the salvage beam and see what the trawl brings up

terrestrial.name: Terrestrial
terrestrial.desc: Balanced planet. All standard buildings available, no special bonuses.

volcanic.name: Volcanic
volcanic.desc: Rich in metal. Special mining & energy buildings, limited agriculture.

frozen.name: Frozen
frozen.desc: Crystal-rich permafrost. Special excavators and cryo research.

ocean.name: Ocean
ocean.desc: Farming paradise. Enormous population potential, weak mining.

uninhabitable.name: Uninhabitable
uninhabitable.desc: Hostile or barren — colonization not possible.

command_center.name: Command Center
command_center.desc: The heart of your colony. Must be built before anything else.
command_center.lv2: Unlocks the Tech Center tile · +5 pop

med_station.name: Med Station
med_station.desc: Grows colonists from vital gel cultures — the only way to grow faster than recruitment allows.

power_plant.name: Power Plant
power_plant.desc: Powers the colony. Build and upgrade to support more buildings.

metal_mine.name: Metal Mine
metal_mine.desc: Extracts metal ore from the surface.

deep_shaft.name: Deep Shaft Frame
deep_shaft.desc: Braces a new shaft with armour plating and works the seam behind it.

survey_array.name: Deep Survey Array
survey_array.desc: Superconducting sensor array that locates rich crystal veins.

alloy_forge.name: Alloy Forge
alloy_forge.desc: Smelts metal into refined alloy. Requires Laboratory Lv 2.

biomass_collector.name: Biomass Collector
biomass_collector.desc: Harvests organic biomass from ocean floors. Requires Laboratory Lv 2.

obsidian_quarry.name: Obsidian Quarry
obsidian_quarry.desc: Excavates volcanic obsidian from lava fields. Requires Laboratory Lv 2.

cryo_extractor.name: Cryo Extractor
cryo_extractor.desc: Harvests cryonite from frozen veins. Requires Laboratory Lv 2.

solar_array.name: Solar Array
solar_array.desc: Harvests solar energy. No energy drain.

cryo_reactor.name: Cryo Reactor
cryo_reactor.desc: Harnesses extreme cold for high-yield energy. Frozen planets only.

alloy_fusion_reactor.name: Alloy Fusion Reactor
alloy_fusion_reactor.desc: Fuses refined alloy for high-yield energy. Terrestrial planets only.

obsidian_plasma_core.name: Obsidian Plasma Core
obsidian_plasma_core.desc: Superheats obsidian into plasma for massive energy output. Volcanic planets only.

biomass_reactor.name: Biomass Reactor
biomass_reactor.desc: Converts biomass into clean sustained energy. Ocean planets only.

drone_hangar.name: Drone Hangar
drone_hangar.desc: Production facility for all drone types. Houses recon drones today, further drones later.

star_map.name: Star Map
star_map.desc: Charts the known galaxy. Required for interplanetary navigation.
star_map.lv2: Unlocks Galaxy view · nearby systems visible
star_map.lv3: Full galaxy scan — all systems visible

interstellar_comm.name: Interstellar Communication
interstellar_comm.desc: Scan distant star systems and contact their inhabitants. Researched once, applied galaxy-wide.

space_building.name: Space Technology
space_building.desc: Advances propulsion and navigation science. Unlocks the Space Base tile.

laboratory.name: Laboratory
laboratory.desc: Drives scientific progress. High energy consumer.

weapons_building.name: Weapon Technology
weapons_building.desc: Military science division. Unlocks the planetary Defense tile.
weapons_building.lv1: Unlocks Defense tile · basic weapon blueprints

plasma_compressor.name: Plasma Compressor
plasma_compressor.desc: Presses plasma cores into fuel cells. Triple the output per run compared to the power cell lab.

shipyard.name: Shipyard
shipyard.desc: Production facility for all starships. Builds colony ships today, further ships later.

geothermal_tap.name: Geothermal Tap
geothermal_tap.desc: Harnesses volcanic heat for cheap, reliable energy output.

tidal_generator.name: Tidal Generator
tidal_generator.desc: Harvests kinetic energy from ocean tides. Cheap and reliable.

alloy_refinery.name: Alloy Refinery
alloy_refinery.desc: Presses metal and alloy into Duraplate hull plating. Buildable anywhere — the alloy is the hard part.

obsidian_foundry.name: Obsidian Foundry
obsidian_foundry.desc: Superheats obsidian and crystal into Plasma Cores. Buildable anywhere — the obsidian is the hard part.

cryo_refinery.name: Cryo Refinery
cryo_refinery.desc: Grows Superconductors from crystal in a cryonite bath. Buildable anywhere — the cryonite is the hard part.

bio_lab.name: Bio Lab
bio_lab.desc: Cultures biomass and metal into life-supporting Vital Gel. Buildable anywhere — the biomass is the hard part.

salvage_smelter.name: Salvage Smelter
salvage_smelter.desc: Melts scrap into metal, crystal and this planet's own raw — and, slowly and dearly, into any refined good.
salvage_smelter.lv1: Melt scrap into raw material and refined goods

power_cell_lab.name: Power Cell Lab
power_cell_lab.desc: Manufactures universal power cells for starships.

shield_generator.name: Shield Generator
shield_generator.desc: Projects an energy barrier around the planet. Charged with crystal, fades over time.

orbital_defense.name: Orbital Defense
orbital_defense.desc: Tracks foreign spy satellites over the planet and shoots them down.
